name: Bentota
line: River and beach within easy reach of the airport, for a first or last night.

image.alt: A table set on the sand as a couple walk the beach

summary: A river, a long beach and good hotels, about two hours from the airport. The easy first or last night.

intro.heading: An easy start, or an easy finish.
paragraphs: Bentota is where the Bentota river meets the sea, on the west coast south of Colombo. There is a long beach on the ocean side, a calm lagoon on the other, and some of the island’s best-run beach hotels between them.
Many long-haul flights land late at night or leave early in the morning. A night here rather than in the city means you start or finish the trip by the sea, without a long drive in either direction.

mapCaption: On the west coast, south of Colombo. The other dots are the places we pair it with.

doing.lede: Bentota is for recovering from a flight, or resting before one. These are the things we fill the time with.

items.title: A boat up the river
items.body: Mangroves, water monitors and kingfishers, on a slow boat from the jetty, with a stop at a cinnamon garden.

items.title: Lunuganga
items.body: Geoffrey Bawa’s country estate on the lake, and the garden he spent fifty years shaping. Open for guided visits.

items.title: Brief Garden
items.body: The house and garden of his brother Bevis, a short drive inland, with the sculpture and the planting much as he left them.

items.title: A day on the lagoon
items.body: Kayaks, paddleboards or nothing at all, on water that stays calm when the sea is rough.

season: Bentota is on the west coast, so it follows the south and west: at its best from December to April, and wet from May to September. The river and the lagoon are good in any month.
ctaBody: Tell us your flight times and we will put it at the start or the end of the route.
